description: Reviewed-change allowlist for pre_implementation_check.py. Entries here suppress RISK_SENSITIVE_PATTERNS violations for the exact (file, pattern) pair ONLY after explicit human review. BLOCKED_CHANGES can never be allowlisted. SCOPE: an entry auto-allows ANY future diff matching the same (file, pattern) - re-review if risk logic in that file changes. Add entries ONLY via: python scripts/pre_implementation_check.py --allow-add <file> --pattern <pattern> --reason "..." (hand-editing bypasses pattern/blocked-file validation and breaks the audit trail)
